title: Love it! But it seems to overly advertise their pro feature.
body:
I’d definitely recommend this app if your schedule is messy or if you tend to procrastinate. It helped me complete tasks on time, anf the mood check ins were a good touch.

However, I wasn’t a fan of how the app promotes its Pro feature. You can’t even add more than six tasks without being prompted to upgrade. I couldn’t add a seventh task because it required payment, which was frustrating. When I checked the Pro benefits, it mostly talked about better quality features, but didn’t clearly mention the task limit.

If you’re someone who likes to plan a lot in your day, this might not be the best app for you. Still, putting the aggressive Pro advertisements aside, it’s a great tool overall.

title: Got annoyed within the first 5 minutes
body:
I totally get that app developers want to make money (and so they should) but there’s a fine line between “support us” and “let’s pressure you into subscribing”. It’s a shame because this app seems to have quite a lot of potential but unfortunately I deleted the app within 5 minutes of trying to set it up due to the fact that after it kept giving me pop ups for subscription offers that I wasn’t interested in. 

For a wellness app they love to pressure you into subscribing and paying. Based on this I wouldn’t recommend unless you’re willing to subscribe. I wanted to test it out before having to commit to a 12 month subscription (and I don’t deem a 7 day “free” trial is a suitable option as it still asks for payment details) but couldn’t get over the irony of a wellness app pressuring me over and over again through constant pop ups around paying them money.
